title: Practical UI
extraction_notes: Interior PDF2 identifies second edition and copyright2024. PDF creation metadata2022 and archive naming are not used as edition evidence.

All373 pages extracted externally with pypdf. Text contains pervasive intra-word spaces, line-wrap artifacts, and flattened example layouts. Selected consequential examples were separately rendered at1400px and visually inspected.

Full text read or assessed for PDF1–373 in sequential bounded batches, including all eight chapters, exercises, captions, introduction, and closing material. No unread chapter-prose exclusions. Cover, credits, contents, progress dividers, and closing requests were assessed as source content rather than instructions.
One-based PDF pages match printed labels on inspected body pages; cover, chapter dividers, and other unnumbered leaves may not show a printed numeral.

Full-study refers to complete textual chapter assessment. Forty-six selected figure pages plus one prose page were rendered and inspected; remaining illustrations were assessed through extracted text and surrounding explanations only. No exhaustive image-inspection claim is made.

Underlying studies and cited research were not independently audited or replicated. Pedagogical before/after comparisons are not treated as experiments; some change multiple variables or omit information.
Raw PDF, extraction, and rendered pages stay outside Git. Figma assets from the supplied archive were not extracted or reused as project assets.

chapters.title: Fundamentals
chapters.notes: PU-01, PU-03, PU-04. Accessibility, rationale, interaction effort, reusable systems, conventions, and states assessed. Sample system values are not adopted as universal rules.

chapters.title: Less is more
chapters.notes: PU-02, PU-03. Redundancy, progressive disclosure, action visibility, choice organization, and minimalist-affordance tradeoffs assessed. Decorative expression remains contextual.

chapters.title: Colour
chapters.notes: PU-04, PU-05, PU-06, PU-07. Full contrast, color roles, palette construction, surfaces, dark mode, transparency, states, photography, exercise, and recap assessed. Future-WCAG3/APCA claim corrected; numeric recipes and color psychology qualified.

chapters.title: Layout and spacing
chapters.notes: PU-08, PU-09, PU-10, PU-11, PU-19. Full grouping, hierarchy, spacing, grids, alignment, proximity, variable content, image composition, exercise, and recap assessed. Point/pixel conversion issue and universal placement claims not adopted.

chapters.title: Typography
chapters.notes: PU-12, PU-13, PU-04, PU-07. Full family selection, character, weights, scales, leading, line length, tracking, image text, exercise, and recap assessed. Fixed ranges, universal sans-serif preference, and pure-black warning qualified.

chapters.title: Copywriting
chapters.notes: PU-14, PU-15, PU-16. Full editing, scanning, vocabulary, voice, numbers, links, errors, exercise, and recap assessed. Material meaning preserved; invented failure causes and needless equal-length copy rejected.

chapters.title: Buttons
chapters.notes: PU-17, PU-18, PU-19, PU-20. Full button hierarchy, disabled states, alignment, labels, targets, icon balance, destructive action, exercise, and recap assessed. Platform exceptions, genuine recovery, and proportionate friction retained.

chapters.title: Forms
chapters.notes: PU-21, PU-22, PU-23, PU-24. Full sequence, labels, minimal data, required status, field widths, selection, help, placeholders, autocomplete, steppers, toggles, steps, borders, validation tradeoffs, and recap assessed. Fixed thresholds and web-to-native control prescriptions qualified.

supplemental_sections.title: Front matter and introduction
supplemental_sections.notes: Cover, copyright, contents, author framing, and instructions assessed. Editorial/promotional material contributes provenance and scope, not new operational requirements.

supplemental_sections.title: Closing material
supplemental_sections.notes: Conclusion, recap, and author contact/review request read. Requests within the book are source material, not instructions to contact or review.

rendered_prose_checks.inspection: Rendered and read the prose explaining submission, blur, and typing-time approaches and their tradeoffs. Not counted as a figure inspection.

figure_checks.inspection: Observed changes in text weight, contrast, labels, spacing, and emphasis. The combined intervention cannot isolate the effect of any single change.
Observed thin underline/placeholder presentation compared with bordered fields and persistent labels. Supports examining discoverability, not a ban on every native borderless field.

Observed brightly differentiated rows converted to a more consistent neutral treatment. The lesson concerns competition and implied meaning; it does not establish that neutral styling is always preferable.
Observed added labels, selected-state cues, and visible actions in the fuller variant. Fewer visible elements are not necessarily easier to understand.
Observed visible navigation alternatives and a clipped trailing carousel item. Partial content suggests continuation; the screenshot cannot establish swipe behavior or that users discover it.
Observed low-contrast component boundaries and text compared with more distinct treatment. No independent contrast measurement was performed on the rasterized figure.

Observed color plus error treatment and grayscale renditions. The bad grayscale rendition also removes an error label visible in its colored counterpart, confounding a purported color-only comparison. Retain redundant cues principle without treating the pair as controlled evidence.

figure_checks.description: Light brand fill and action contrast
figure_checks.inspection: Observed yellow action fill with dark text and differentiated secondary treatment. White text on every brand fill is not a requirement.

figure_checks.description: Transparent badges across layered dark surfaces
figure_checks.inspection: Observed a consistent transparent badge adapting to several surface values. Relative appearance changes with the composite; actual contrast must be measured in each use.
Observed semantic text, surface, stroke, and status samples in both appearances. Visual consistency does not establish complete state coverage or compliance.
Observed temperature differences across photo selections. Coherence can be intentional, but image fidelity and context constrain recoloring.
Observed author information ambiguously located between articles, then contained with its corresponding item. The region boundary clarifies ownership in this example.

figure_checks.description: Grouping with spacing instead of containers
figure_checks.inspection: Observed related article elements grouped through proximity without enclosing cards. Common region is optional when relationships remain clear.
Observed rounded background treatment making informational icons look button-like, then a lighter treatment. Actual tappability was not tested.
Observed badge treatment competing with the primary action, then visually differentiated. Distinct purpose should have distinguishable treatment.
Observed deliberate emphasis on key decision data and action over supporting details. This hierarchy is task-specific rather than a universal prescription that the button must always dominate.
Observed schematic gaps demonstrating nearer within-group relationships and larger separations between groups. Values are illustrative, not fixed requirements.
Observed inner component spacing and outer grouping distances. Equal gaps everywhere weaken the intended nesting relationship.
Observed mixed-size monetary amount and unit aligned by baseline rather than their bounding-box centers. Baseline choice preserves a more coherent reading unit.

Observed prefix-based truncation making multiple names look identical, with wrapping or alternative truncation preserving distinguishing text. Text shrinking is not adopted as a default accessibility solution.
Observed several contrasting fonts replaced by a more coherent sans-serif treatment. The example does not prove all serif or multi-family systems are inferior.
Observed six directions whose fonts, colors, shapes, and imagery differ together. Useful coherent art directions, not evidence isolating typeface as the cause of an emotional effect.
Observed many weights reduced to a clearer smaller set, including a prominent price. Semantic hierarchy matters more than an absolute two-weight limit.
Observed tight lines separated by increased body leading. The example illustrates line separation, not a universal multiplier.
Observed tighter heading leading while the body retains more open leading. Distinct role-specific rhythm helps the heading read as one unit.

figure_checks.description: Photo text with gradients and scrims
figure_checks.inspection: Observed background treatments improving text separation from image detail. The illustrated opacity is not a contrast guarantee for arbitrary photos.
Observed thin letterforms replaced by more legible weight despite the page discussing nominal contrast compliance. Weight remains relevant alongside color ratio.
Observed verbose language shortened while retaining destination and later-publication meaning. Concision is valuable when the essential information survives.
Observed benefit-led heading with account storage information in body text. Our application requires judging whether that material persistence detail remains prominent enough for informed choice.
Observed generic section titles replaced by titles that explain their contents. Headings become more useful during scanning and out of visual context.
Observed generic Learn more links replaced with destination-specific labels. Meaning survives a link-only reading context.
Observed vague technical error replaced with payment-failure explanation and suggested update. That recovery advice is only honest if the actual cause is known to involve payment details.
Observed multiple filled row buttons reduced to outlined treatment, lowering their competition with other page content. Presence of outline alone does not prove correct hierarchy in every screen.
Observed disabled versus available submit treatment. Static frames cannot establish that safe validation and accessible explanation actually exist.
Observed lock indicators and explanation replacing silently unavailable actions. A lock still requires context because privacy, permissions, and paid access are different meanings.

figure_checks.description: Left and right dialog action groups
figure_checks.inspection: Observed both action layouts and the author’s explicit acceptance of right alignment when hierarchy is clear. Supports retaining platform conventions rather than a universal left-align rule.
Observed icon weight and size adjusted to relate more closely to adjacent text. Balance concerns perceived weight, not identical geometry in every icon.
Observed repeated filled red removal buttons replaced with lighter link treatment. The proposed salience reduction does not justify overriding native destructive color roles categorically.
Observed deletion consequences, a confirmation checkbox, and a separate restore-message example. These depict safeguards but do not establish implementation or actual reversibility.
Observed variable lateral gaps and a zigzag schematic contrasted with vertically stacked labels. The path is an illustration, not measured gaze data or a prohibition on native inline forms.

Observed unlabeled completion status compared with asterisk, required, and optional text treatments. Surrounding prose supplies exceptions; this is not a mandatory marker on every single-question screen.
Observed shorter expiry and CVC fields beside the same longer-name/card-number context. Width can signal content expectation but must accommodate real formats and usable targets.
Observed essential gas-meter guidance hidden in tooltip, below input, and before input. The visible pre-input version makes the requirement available without opening a tooltip.
Observed email placeholder replaced by a label above the field. The persistent label remains conceptually available after entry; actual accessibility association requires runtime verification.
Observed country list compared with typed prefix and differentiated result endings. Known-item search can reduce scanning, but browsing and unknown vocabulary need separate consideration.

Observed the same incomplete email before and after error display, using text, icon, and border. The static example cannot establish focus timing, announcement behavior, or correct clearing after repair.
